claims.claim: Helium, a 7B text LLM pretrained on 2.1T tokens of public English data
claims.quote: We present Helium, a 7B-parameter text LLM that we pretrain on 2.1T tokens of public English data.

claims.claim: Mimi neural audio codec distilling semantic information into first level of acoustic tokens with improved training tricks
claims.quote: We rather extend the approach of Zhang et al. (2024b) by distilling semantic information into the first level of acoustic tokens and introduce improved training tricks.

claims.claim: New hierarchical streaming architecture (Helium + small Depth Transformer, RQ-Transformer) for audio tokens
claims.quote: a new architecture for audio language modeling, which combines Helium with a smaller Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) model to predict audio
claims.ablation_quote: In that context, modeling RVQ tokens with an RQ-Transformer significantly improves perplexity over using separate classification heads.

claims.claim: First multi-stream audio language model for full-duplex dialogue
claims.quote: We furthermore introduce the first multi-stream audio language model, i.e. a model that explicitly processes the input and output audio streams jointly into two autoregressive token streams.

claims.claim: Inner Monologue: predicting time-aligned text tokens as prefix to audio tokens
claims.quote: we introduce Inner Monologue, a new training and inference setup for audio language models that significantly improves the factuality and linguistic quality of generated speech
claims.ablation_quote: Finally, the most drastic improvement to the quality and length of generated speech comes from enabling Inner Monologue.

claims.claim: Delay between text and audio tokens yields streaming ASR and TTS
claims.quote: forcing a delay between text and audio tokens allows deriving streaming ASR and streaming TTS from a Moshi model.
